# MCP reference

`orion mcp` serves these tools over stdio. Each one runs a CLI command, so it reads and writes the same data.

## orion_workspaces

List Orion workspaces and the active workspace, or the archived ones.

Runs `orion workspace list`.

| Argument   | Type    | Description                       |
| ---------- | ------- | --------------------------------- |
| `archived` | boolean | List archived workspaces instead. |

## orion_inspect

Read the canvas: list items, ready work, groups, PR matches, or one item/group.

| Argument    | Type                                       | Description                                                  |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `view`      | list \| ready \| groups \| matches \| show | **Required.**                                                |
| `workspace` | workspace                                  | Workspace name. Omit to use the workspace selected in Orion. |
| `id`        | id                                         | Required for show.                                           |
| `group`     | id                                         | Limit list to descendants of a group.                        |
| `all`       | boolean                                    | Include completed items in list.                             |

## orion_add_item

Add a work item to the canvas.

Runs `orion add`.

| Argument    | Type                                                    | Description                                                                                               |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title`     | string                                                  | **Required.**                                                                                             |
| `workspace` | workspace                                               | Workspace name. Omit to use the workspace selected in Orion.                                              |
| `group`     | id                                                      |                                                                                                           |
| `repo`      | string                                                  | Deprecated: with pr, use ref with the pull request URL instead.                                           |
| `pr`        | int                                                     | Deprecated: use ref with the pull request URL instead.                                                    |
| `ref`       | string                                                  | Outside work to attach: a GitHub or Jira URL, source:key such as jira:ABC-1, or branch:owner/name@branch. |
| `status`    | todo \| active \| review \| blocked \| deferred \| done |                                                                                                           |

## orion_update_item

Change fields on an existing Orion item or group.

Runs `orion set`.

| Argument    | Type                                                    | Description                                                                                               |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`        | id                                                      | **Required.**                                                                                             |
| `workspace` | workspace                                               | Workspace name. Omit to use the workspace selected in Orion.                                              |
| `label`     | string                                                  |                                                                                                           |
| `status`    | todo \| active \| review \| blocked \| deferred \| done |                                                                                                           |
| `who`       | you \| review \| ci \|                                  | Whose move: you, review, or ci. Empty clears it.                                                          |
| `note`      | string                                                  |                                                                                                           |
| `repo`      | string                                                  | Deprecated: with pr, use ref with the pull request URL instead.                                           |
| `pr`        | int                                                     | Deprecated: use ref with the pull request URL instead.                                                    |
| `ref`       | string                                                  | Outside work to attach: a GitHub or Jira URL, source:key such as jira:ABC-1, or branch:owner/name@branch. |

## orion_add_note

Add a canvas note, optionally inside a group or a dependency link.

Runs `orion note`.

| Argument    | Type      | Description                                                  |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `text`      | string    | **Required.**                                                |
| `workspace` | workspace | Workspace name. Omit to use the workspace selected in Orion. |
| `group`     | id        |                                                              |
| `after`     | id        |                                                              |
| `before`    | id        |                                                              |

## orion_images

List image nodes in an Orion workspace.

Runs `orion media list`.

| Argument    | Type      | Description                                                  |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `workspace` | workspace | Workspace name. Omit to use the workspace selected in Orion. |

## orion_add_image

Import a local PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP file as an image node. The CLI copies it into the workspace assets folder.

Runs `orion media insert`.

| Argument    | Type      | Description                                                  |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `path`      | string    | **Required.** Absolute path to a local image file.           |
| `label`     | string    |                                                              |
| `workspace` | workspace | Workspace name. Omit to use the workspace selected in Orion. |
| `group`     | id        |                                                              |

## orion_link

Connect two items, optionally as a related link that does not block work.

Runs `orion link`.

| Argument    | Type      | Description                                                  |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `from`      | id        | **Required.**                                                |
| `to`        | id        | **Required.**                                                |
| `workspace` | workspace | Workspace name. Omit to use the workspace selected in Orion. |
| `related`   | boolean   |                                                              |

## orion_unlink

Remove a dependency or related link between two items.

Runs `orion unlink`.

| Argument    | Type      | Description                                                  |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `from`      | id        | **Required.**                                                |
| `to`        | id        | **Required.**                                                |
| `workspace` | workspace | Workspace name. Omit to use the workspace selected in Orion. |

## orion_group

Wrap existing items in a new group.

Runs `orion group`.

| Argument    | Type      | Description                                                  |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `label`     | string    | **Required.**                                                |
| `items`     | strings   | **Required.**                                                |
| `workspace` | workspace | Workspace name. Omit to use the workspace selected in Orion. |

## orion_move

Move an item into a group or to the top level.

Runs `orion move`.

| Argument    | Type      | Description                                                  |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`        | id        | **Required.**                                                |
| `workspace` | workspace | Workspace name. Omit to use the workspace selected in Orion. |
| `group`     | id        |                                                              |

## orion_remove

Delete an item or group from the canvas.

Runs `orion remove`.

| Argument    | Type      | Description                                                  |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`        | id        | **Required.**                                                |
| `workspace` | workspace | Workspace name. Omit to use the workspace selected in Orion. |

## orion_create_workspace

Create an Orion workspace. Without a name, one is derived from the label.

Runs `orion workspace create`.

| Argument | Type      | Description                                       |
| -------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`   | workspace | Workspace name. Omit it to derive one from label. |
| `label`  | string    | Display label. Required when name is omitted.     |

## orion_rename_workspace

Change a workspace's display label. The name and folder stay the same.

Runs `orion workspace rename`.

| Argument | Type      | Description   |
| -------- | --------- | ------------- |
| `name`   | workspace | **Required.** |
| `label`  | string    | **Required.** |

## orion_archive_workspace

Archive a workspace so it leaves the workspace list. Its data stays in place. The active workspace can't be archived.

Runs `orion workspace archive`.

| Argument | Type      | Description   |
| -------- | --------- | ------------- |
| `name`   | workspace | **Required.** |

## orion_restore_workspace

Restore an archived Orion workspace with its data.

Runs `orion workspace restore`.

| Argument | Type      | Description   |
| -------- | --------- | ------------- |
| `name`   | workspace | **Required.** |

## orion_select_workspace

Set the active Orion workspace shown by the app.

Runs `orion workspace use`.

| Argument | Type      | Description   |
| -------- | --------- | ------------- |
| `name`   | workspace | **Required.** |

## orion_sync

Refresh pull request cards from GitHub. Discovery adds open authored PRs to Inbox when requested.

Runs `orion sync`.

| Argument    | Type      | Description                                                  |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `workspace` | workspace | Workspace name. Omit to use the workspace selected in Orion. |
| `dryRun`    | boolean   |                                                              |
| `discover`  | boolean   |                                                              |

## orion_import

Add a card for each GitHub or Jira URL, or source:key, in one step. Refs already on the canvas are skipped. Refs that don't resolve are reported and skipped, and the call fails if any did.

Runs `orion import`.

| Argument    | Type      | Description                                                  |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `workspace` | workspace | Workspace name. Omit to use the workspace selected in Orion. |
| `refs`      | strings   | **Required.**                                                |
| `group`     | id        |                                                              |
| `dryRun`    | boolean   |                                                              |
